scope: Budget selection from real smoke throughput only, before any formal training or dev outcome
vae_cap_seconds: round_up_to_60(1.5 * 1000 * max_across_3_arms(mean recorded VAE update duration) + 120)
ddpm_cap_seconds: round_up_to_60(1.5 * 1000 * max_across_3_arms(mean recorded DDPM update duration) + 120)
common_total_training_cap_seconds: vae_cap_seconds + ddpm_cap_seconds; if sum exceeds3600, do not auto-launch and record budget infeasibility
generation_cap_basis: Frozen H4 actual full generation1126.20s for96 shared requests, of which32 terminal-DDPM requests dominate;1800 is finite headroom, not a runtime prediction
ar_basis: 1000 updates approximately111epochs for279 rows,batch32; source LSTM_peptides example100epochs. Same maximum runtime, different actual cost. Do not deliberately spend unused cap through overtraining.
monitoring: every100 VAE/AR updates,10fixed points; no checkpoint or hyperparameter selection; time charged to training cap
if_smoke_training_fails: No formal automatic launch until independent diagnosis and separately frozen correction. Preserve failed smoke.
if_smoke_generation_fails: Retain every failure. Independent diagnosis distinguishes implementation defect from undertrained numerical generation instability; no sigma clipping, retry or fewer reverse steps. Formal authorization requires explicit recorded justification and keeps finite failure policy.
